title: OpenAI's o1 correctly diagnosed 67% of ER patients vs. 50-55% by triage doctors
body:
OpenAI's o1 correctly diagnosed 67% of ER patients vs. 50-55% by triage doctors

AI outperforms doctors in Harvard trial of emergency triage diagnoses | The Guardian. Harvard study compared OpenAI's o1 reasoning model to human triage doctors on the same charts, vitals, and intake notes. o1 correctly diagnosed 67% of ER patients; human doctors landed between 50% and 55%. The base model wasn't fine-tuned for medicine.

HN discussion: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47991981 (score=123)
